process async. Redis SETNX on event_id drops most duplicate deliveries from Workday retries. Redis is a first filter, not the guarantee: every sink is idempotent on event_id, so a duplicate that gets past Redis changes nothing." id="wh"> <mxCell parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=1.5;shadow=1;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1E293B;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="420" x="580" y="350" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="<b>Apache Kafka:</b> 3 brokers, RF=3, 7-day retention<br>topics (key = emp_id): workday.hire, workday.term, workday.job_change, workday.comp_change, workday.org_change" tooltip="emp_id as partition key keeps each employee's events in order within a topic. Kafka does not order events across topics (e.g. hire vs job change), so the sinks apply events by event timestamp: the newer event wins and older ones are ignored. 7-day retention allows replay after downstream outages; the Delta archive covers replay beyond that." id="kf"> <mxCell parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=1.5;shadow=1;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1E293B;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="420" x="580" y="520" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <mxCell id="spd" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F5F3FF;strokeColor=#7C3AED;verticalAlign=top;align=center;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=4;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#6D28D9;" value="SPEED LAYER: Azure Cloud (Low latency)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="330" width="460" x="560" y="700" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <UserObject label="<b>Spark Structured Streaming</b> (Azure Databricks)<div>• Reads Kafka over ExpressRoute<br>• 30-second trigger; foreachBatch<br>• At-least-once; idempotent writes to 3 sinks (keyed on event_id)</div>" tooltip="Delivery is at-least-once: after a failure, the last micro-batch is replayed from the checkpoint. Every sink is idempotent on event_id (Cassandra upsert by primary key, MongoDB update guarded by event time, Delta MERGE), so replays do not double-apply events. Checkpoints in ADLS." id="sp"> <mxCell parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#7C3AED;strokeWidth=1.5;shadow=1;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1E293B;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="420" x="580" y="740" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <mxCell id="k1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#7C3AED;strokeWidth=1.5;shadow=1;fontSize=9;fontColor=#1E293B;" value="<b>Cassandra</b><br>Azure VMs | 3 nodes | RF=3<br>90-day TTL<br>PK emp_id | CK event_dt DESC, event_id" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="130" x="580" y="895" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="k2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#7C3AED;strokeWidth=1.5;shadow=1;fontSize=9;fontColor=#1E293B;" value="<b>MongoDB</b><br>On-prem via ExpressRoute<br>$set profile fields<br>guarded by event time (newer wins)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="130" x="725" y="895" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="k3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=10;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#7C3AED;strokeWidth=1.5;shadow=1;fontSize=9;fontColor=#1E293B;" value="<b>ADLS Delta Lake</b><br>Archive of all events<br>MERGE on event_id<br>Replay beyond Kafka retention" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="130" x="870" y="895" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <UserObject label="<b>RECONCILIATION</b><div>(runs after batch completes)<br><br>1. Batch rebuild sets the profile <b>floor</b> (state at the extraction watermark)<br>2. Query Cassandra for events after the watermark<br>3. Re-apply them to MongoDB (idempotent, newer wins)<br>4. div.div: REAL-TIME INGESTION: On-premises

g.title: Design decision: acknowledge fast, process async. Redis SETNX on event_id drops most duplicate deliveries from Workday retries. Redis is a first filter, not the guarantee: every sink is idempotent on event_id, so a duplicate that gets past Redis changes nothing.

div.div:
Webhook receiver: Python Flask + nginx
• OAuth token validation
• JSON payload parsing
• Redis dedup check (5-min TTL)
• Route to Kafka topic; acknowledge Workday within 3 s

g.title: emp_id as partition key keeps each employee's events in order within a topic. Kafka does not order events across topics (e.g. hire vs job change), so the sinks apply events by event timestamp: the newer event wins and older ones are ignored. 7-day retention allows replay after downstream outages; the Delta archive covers replay beyond that.

div.div: SPEED LAYER: Azure Cloud (Low latency)

g.title: Delivery is at-least-once: after a failure, the last micro-batch is replayed from the checkpoint. Every sink is idempotent on event_id (Cassandra upsert by primary key, MongoDB update guarded by event time, Delta MERGE), so replays do not double-apply events. Checkpoints in ADLS.

g.title: Design decision: batch remains the source of truth. Events up to the extraction watermark are already in the batch, so only later events are re-applied. This stops the nightly rebuild from overwriting fresher real-time updates. Differences found in step 4 are logged and alerted.

div.div:
(runs after batch completes)
1. Batch rebuild sets the profile floor (state at the extraction watermark)
2. Query Cassandra for events after the watermark
3. Re-apply them to MongoDB (idempotent, newer wins)
4. Verify final state = batch floor + newer events

a.title: Every event is upserted by primary key (emp_id, event_dt, event_id), so a replay writes the same row again. Rows expire after 90 days. Phase 4 plans to replace Cassandra with a Delta event table (ADR-0012). Click for the ADRs.

path.style: stroke: light-dark(rgb(124, 58, 237), rgb(197, 141, 255)); animation: 500ms linear 0s infinite normal none running ge-flow-animation-mjGNqprIL-H69t1gc1GP; stroke-dashoffset: 16;

a.title: Only the affected profile fields are updated with $set, and only if the event is newer than what the profile already holds. A late or replayed event changes nothing. Click for the Phase 3 code.

path.style: stroke: light-dark(rgb(124, 58, 237), rgb(197, 141, 255)); animation: 500ms linear 0s infinite normal none running ge-flow-animation-mjGNqprIL-H69t1gc1GP; stroke-dashoffset: 16;

a.title: Every event is archived to Delta with MERGE on event_id, so duplicates are written once. The archive allows replay beyond Kafka's 7-day retention and becomes the basis for Phase 4. Click for ADR-0010.

div.div:
ORCHESTRATION: Apache Airflow
DAGs generated from YAML | Dependencies inferred from configs | Daily 2:00 AM | Batch DAGs + reconciliation DAG + stream-health sensor
Retries 3 | Resume from failed step | Teams + ServiceNow alerts | SLA 5:30 AM (design target)
